description: Per-security holdings from SEC Form N-PORT: one row per holding line in a mutual fund, ETF or closed-end fund's monthly portfolio report, parsed from the filing's primary_doc.xml; filing_id ties each row to get_nport_filings. Use it for which funds hold a security, a fund's portfolio, derivative exposure or repo positions. Size a derivative with min_notional, not min_value_usd: fair value and exposure differ by orders of magnitude. Derivative and debt terms are being backfilled: a null term on an older filing means not yet extracted, not absent from the source. Coverage: N-PORT filings FILED from 2024-06-01; an empty result for a filing means not extracted, not an empty fund. Field list and details: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_fund_holdings

asset_cat.description: SEC code, case-insensitive: EC common equity; EP preferred equity; DBT debt, Treasuries included; LON loan; ABS-MBS asset-backed, mortgage; ABS-O asset-backed, other; ABS-CBDO asset-backed, CDO/CBO; ABS-APCP asset-backed commercial paper; SN structured note; STIV short-term investment vehicle, money-market and liquidity pools; RA repurchase and reverse-repurchase agreement; RE real estate; COMM commodity; DE equity derivative; DIR interest-rate derivative; DFE foreign-exchange derivative; DCR credit derivative; DCO commodity derivative; DO other derivative; OTHER other. Other codes are refused.

counterparty.description: Counterparty substring, case-insensitive. The source's literal 'N/A' is kept, not nulled.

country.description: ISO-2 country code of the holding.

cusip.description: Exact 9-character CUSIP; the most reliable identifier in N-PORT.

expiration_since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on deriv_expiration_date; rows whose expiration is 'N/A' are excluded.

filer_cik.description: Fund trust CIK, 10-digit: the precise form, one trust.

filer_name.description: Trust-name substring; it matches a FAMILY ('BlackRock': five+ trusts, 300,000+ rows). Use filer_cik, or narrow with period_ending.

filing_id.description: EDGAR accession: every holding in one fund-month filing.

is_derivative.description: true: derivative rows only; false: non-derivative only.

isin.description: Exact; present only where the filer gave one.

min_notional.description: Minimum notional in the contract's currency (exposure). Excludes rows with none, options included.

min_pct_of_portfolio.description: Minimum % of fund net assets, 0-100 scale.

min_value_usd.description: Minimum fair value in USD (what it is worth, not exposure).

name.description: Issuer-name substring. 1-2 letters: whole word, newest 20,000 holdings only.

sort_by.description: Default value_usd (fair value, which understates derivatives).

ticker.description: Exact; present only where the filer gave one (less often than CUSIP).

name: get_fund_holdings
